headings.ru: Документ(ы), на основании которого(ых) ведется разработка
headings.guidance: Identify supplied formal authorization or approved specifications only. If none is supplied, say so briefly and distinguish source material used for this explanatory note from documents authorizing development.

headings.en: Brief description of the application area

headings.ru: Описание и обоснование выбора состава технических и программных средст
headings.en: Description and rationale of hardware and software selection

headings.guidance: List actual implementation technologies, external tools and provider/network needs. Separate build-time tools from runtime dependencies. Do not invent numeric hardware requirements; explain what resource validation would be needed without pretending it was performed.

headings.ru: Обоснование выбора технических и программных средств
headings.en: Rationale for hardware and software selection
headings.guidance: State observed technology choices. If historical design rationale is not supplied, label technical considerations as inferred or proposed rather than attributing them to the authors. Do not claim measured speed or cost advantages.

headings.en: Description and rationale of program architecture
headings.guidance: Trace the actual command/API entry points, business functions, external provider calls and output writing. Do not call an implemented capability future work because it is absent from one excerpt. Explain a concrete source-supported flow.
Give the primary end-to-end user workflow using the actual commands, flags and output paths. Distinguish optional helper commands from the main generation and compilation path.

headings.ru: Обоснование выбора метода организации входных и выходных данных
headings.en: Rationale for input and output organization
headings.guidance: Explain actual input/configuration loading and output writing/compilation paths. Distinguish generated section files, optional bundled files and final artifacts. Do not infer filename suffixes or assume the application never invokes its external compiler.
Provide a qualitative evaluation method and explicit unknown measurement inputs. Do not manufacture hours saved, cost totals, percentages or financial return.
Describe intended users and possible demand as hypotheses; no invented interviews, adoption counts or market measurements.

headings.ru: Экономические преимущества разработки по сравнению с отечественными и зарубежными аналогами
headings.en: Economic advantages over domestic and foreign alternatives
headings.guidance: Provide comparison criteria supported by implementation and identify evidence needed for a fair comparison. Do not assert unmeasured superiority or invent competitor capabilities.

guidance: Describe the supplied existing implementation, not a hypothetical system from embedded examples. Keep technical workflows consistent across sections. Separate verified source behavior, intended benefits, proposed rationale and genuinely unknown formal decisions. Never convert a repository README into an approved development authorization. Do not invent hardware minima, measured productivity savings, market demand or comparative performance.
